purpose: Index public adversarial EU legal-research cases without duplicating their underlying legal evidence.
reuse_policy: Every case in this public seed is scientifically exposed and is regression-only for future evaluation. Fresh blind validation requires a new independently selected and sealed case.

trap_classes.SOURCE_STATE_BACKPROJECTION: A current or consolidated representation contains later corrections or information that cannot prove the source state visible at the nominal historical date.
trap_classes.REPRESENTATION_LOCAL_MARKER_IDENTITY: Presentation markers or ordinals are local to a language/expression and are unsafe as cross-expression legal identities.
trap_classes.DYNAMIC_REFERENCE_STATUS: Legal effect changes because the authoritative status of a referenced external item changes while the parent rule or external identifier remains unchanged.
trap_classes.STATUS_APPLICATION_SEPARATION: Authoritative status or set membership and downstream legal applicability begin or end at different legal boundaries.
trap_classes.AUTHORITATIVE_FINDING_TO_SPATIAL_EFFECT: An authoritative categorical real-world finding triggers legal geography under unchanged law.
trap_classes.SUBDAY_TEMPORAL_BOUNDARY: A legally material boundary occurs at a time finer than calendar-date granularity.
trap_classes.VERTICAL_SPATIAL_EXTENT: Legal geography is volumetric and cannot be represented safely as horizontal geometry alone.
trap_classes.JUDICIAL_VALIDITY_TEXT_DIVERGENCE: A judicial holding changes validity or operative legal state while the target text remains printed or textually unchanged.
trap_classes.PRIVATE_ORIGIN_LEGAL_RECOGNITION: A private-origin output, technical artifact or determination can have a bounded legal role because public law recognises, approves, incorporates or adopts it, without converting the private source into a public authority.
trap_classes.PARALLEL_INSTRUMENT_LIFECYCLE: An umbrella negotiation or political deal is implemented through legally distinct interim and comprehensive agreements whose signature, provisional application, conclusion, entry into force and replacement states must remain attached to the correct instrument.
trap_classes.OFFICIAL_TRACKER_UPDATE_LAG: A currently accessible official summary/status tracker lags newer primary legal sources, so current access time cannot be substituted for the tracker's observation or update horizon.
trap_classes.OFFICIAL_AUTHORITY_HANDOFF: An official specialist artifact may be complete or final within its upstream role while a different institution owns the downstream binding decision; legal effect must remain attached to the procedure's actual decision owner and binding act rather than inherited from upstream authority, finality or practical importance.
trap_classes.AUTHORITATIVE_DATA_INPUT_TRIGGER: An authoritative quantitative observation, value set or versioned reference dataset enters an unchanged legal formula or method and changes the operative calculation/compliance output without parent-text mutation; historical reconstruction must preserve the authoritative data version and its application state.
trap_classes.MACHINE_COMPLIANCE_ARTIFACT: A legally consequential calculation, declaration, submission or verification depends on a prescribed, authoritative, privileged or certified machine-actionable artifact such as an executable tool, ruleset, schema or semantic profile; artifact identity, version or regulatory status is legally relevant evidence, so substituting another/current artifact can change the accepted result or validation consequence without parent-text mutation.
trap_classes.JUDICIAL_INTERPRETATION_TEMPORAL_EFFECT: A preliminary ruling normally clarifies the interpreted EU rule from that rule's own entry into force; the judgment date is not a default new prospective start, while any express Court-imposed limitation of temporal effects is an exceptional legal boundary that must be preserved.
trap_classes.LANGUAGE_AUTHENTICITY_SCOPE_ASYMMETRY: Officially available language expressions can differ in legal authenticity or corrective scope; the existence, wording or legal effect of one language expression must not be projected onto another without evidence of the relevant authenticity/scope rule.

cases.title: Regulation 794/2004 consolidation incorporates later corrigenda
cases.decisive_trap: A consolidation date is not proof that every correction now rendered there was officially available on that date.

cases.title: Dutch expression outside the 2026 corrigendum language list
cases.decisive_trap: A non-listed authentic language is NO_ASSERTION from the corrigendum even when independent source evidence shows equivalent wording already existed.

cases.title: EUR-Lex C-markers are expression-local ordinals
cases.decisive_trap: The same corrigendum can carry different C-labels across language expressions and the same C-label can denote different corrections.

cases.title: Toy-safety harmonised-standard restriction changes presumption without parent-text mutation
cases.decisive_trap: The standard identifier and Directive gateway remain unchanged while OJ reference status narrows the presumption of conformity.

cases.title: Stripchat designation and Section 5 applicability diverge
cases.decisive_trap: Designation/removal and the start/end of additional obligations are separated by statutory delay.

cases.title: Published TNAC mechanically changes Market Stability Reserve quantity
cases.decisive_trap: A new official metric value changes the result of an unchanged statutory formula without a textual mutation.

cases.title: Official HPAI finding generates restricted legal geography
cases.decisive_trap: An official real-world disease finding triggers protection/surveillance geography under unchanged law.

cases.title: Skagerrak real-time closure requires offset-aware instant precision
cases.decisive_trap: Date-only storage cannot answer legal-state queries around a 01:00 local start and 00:59 end.

cases.title: Dutch legal airspace volumes require vertical boundaries
cases.decisive_trap: Horizontal geometry alone overstates or misstates a legally bounded 3D airspace volume.

cases.title: Test-Achats invalidity takes effect while Article 5(2) remains printed
cases.decisive_trap: Current printed text does not prove continued legal availability where a CJEU invalidity holding imposed a later effect boundary.

cases.title: Planet49 interpretation does not create a generic judgment-date application start
cases.decisive_trap: Judgment date is source time; it is not automatically a new prospective start date for the interpreted rule.

cases.title: Private S&P rating enters CRR through public-law recognition
cases.decisive_trap: A private rating can be legally relevant through an ECAI recognition/mapping chain without the rating source becoming official.

cases.title: Private notified-body certificate decision has bounded regulatory effect
cases.decisive_trap: A notified body's private certificate decision is legally recognised within a bounded conformity role without becoming a public-authority act.

cases.title: Polish visa-list consolidation back-projects a later corrigendum
cases.decisive_trap: A current consolidation nominally dated 30 December 2025 incorporates a Polish corrigendum published in February 2026.

cases.title: Italian NIS2 Article 33 heading before language-specific corrigendum
cases.decisive_trap: Substantive multilingual interpretation must not erase the historical authentic Italian wording before its later corrigendum.

cases.title: ChatGPT VLOSE designation does not equal immediate Section 5 applicability
cases.decisive_trap: Article 33(6) ties the additional-obligation clock to provider notification rather than designation announcement.

cases.title: EN 60335-1 remains listed while a clause-specific presumption is restricted
cases.decisive_trap: Continued standard listing does not preserve an unrestricted presumption where a specific new restriction is already operative.

cases.title: EU ETS private verifier has a legally recognised but bounded role
cases.decisive_trap: Private origin does not erase a statutorily recognised verification function, while public supervisory powers remain distinct.

cases.title: 13:00 Brussels-time cut-off changes deemed licence lodgement day
cases.decisive_trap: 12:59 and 13:01 on the same calendar day can map to different legally deemed lodgement days.

cases.title: EU-Mercosur ITA provisional application does not equal EMPA entry into force
cases.decisive_trap: The ITA and EMPA are separate instruments: provisional application of the ITA from 1 May 2026 cannot be inherited as entry into force of the EMPA.

cases.title: EU internal conclusion of Mexico ITA does not equal ITA or MGA entry into force
cases.decisive_trap: The EU's July 2026 conclusion of the ITA completed its internal process but did not collapse the remaining reciprocal entry-into-force condition or the separate MGA lifecycle.

cases.title: Commission NIS2 Netherlands tracker lags later Dutch implementing law
cases.decisive_trap: The currently served Commission country page still exposes the May-2025 enforcement state, while Dutch official law implementing NIS2 has been in force since 15 August 2026; the tracker therefore cannot prove absence of current implementing law.

cases.title: Commission NIS2 Sweden tracker lags later Swedish implementing law
cases.decisive_trap: The current Commission country page still shows the May-2025 reasoned-opinion state and a July-2025 update horizon, while Swedish NIS2 implementing law has been in force since 15 January 2026.

cases.title: EU–Chile umbrella modernisation label hides separate ITA/AFA lifecycles
cases.decisive_trap: A generic modernised-agreement row can incorrectly inherit the ITA's 1 February 2025 entry-into-force date as if the separate AFA had fully entered into force.

cases.title: Haringvliet 2015 list state diverges from later judicial validity
cases.decisive_trap: A 2026 legal-history note using the 2015 list alone can miss the later CJEU ruling that the exclusion of Leenheerenpolder was invalid.

cases.title: EN 50434:2014 listing carries a >300 r/min presumption restriction
cases.decisive_trap: Continued harmonised-standard listing does not confer the claimed presumption for a 320 r/min shredder where the OJ reference is expressly restricted above 300 r/min.

cases.title: Temu VLOP status preceded additional Section 5 applicability
cases.decisive_trap: Temu was already a VLOP on 15 June 2024, while the additional VLOP-specific obligations had not yet reached their post-notification application point.

cases.title: EBA final draft fixed-overheads RTS differs from binding Commission market-maker rule
cases.domain: investment-firm prudential requirements / regulatory technical standards
cases.decisive_trap: EBA's December-2020 final draft was final only at the EBA drafting stage; the Commission later added a substantive market-maker trading-fee deduction before adopting the binding Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1455.

cases.title: EBA final draft crowdfunding RTS differs from binding Commission personal-data retention rule
cases.domain: crowdfunding / credit-risk assessment / regulatory technical standards
cases.decisive_trap: EBA's May-2022 final draft imposed a minimum documentation-retention rule, but the Commission later added a substantive maximum five-year boundary for personal data before adopting Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/358.

cases.title: Construction-product environmental declaration depends on Commission software version
cases.decisive_trap: Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 makes Commission software part of the environmental-performance calculation, requires the declaration to identify the software version, and allows a published update voluntarily before it becomes mandatory one year later; today's executable cannot silently stand in for the legally permitted version at an earlier declaration date.

cases.title: Transport-emissions calculation-tool identity changes verification consequences
cases.decisive_trap: Regulation (EU) 2026/1030 gives the Commission calculation tool a privileged verification effect and requires external calculation tools to carry a certification lifecycle and be identified in supporting evidence; tool identity/status is therefore part of the legally relevant calculation record.

cases.title: EU Ecolabel calculations depend on the current Detergent Ingredient Database
cases.decisive_trap: EU Ecolabel criteria require the DID list as the quantitative source for CDV and biodegradability/toxicity calculations and direct users to the latest version; historical or current calculations cannot silently substitute an arbitrary dataset vintage while treating the unchanged criteria text as the whole legal input.

cases.title: eIDAS trusted-list status changes qualified legal effect for the same service
cases.decisive_trap: The same ANF validation-service identity moved from Granted to Withdrawn status in the national trusted list; under eIDAS, qualified status and its legal effects follow the authoritative list status rather than provider identity or mere list presence.

cases.title: Digital Product Passport conformity depends on a versioned authoritative semantic profile
cases.decisive_trap: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 requires DPP data to follow versioned Commission-published data models and semantic definitions from the authoritative machine-readable repository; validating historical or current passport data against the wrong profile version can change machine conformity without any parent-text amendment.

cases.title: Official Asian longhorn beetle finding generates plant-health demarcated geography
cases.decisive_trap: Under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1952, official confirmation of Anoplophora glabripennis triggers infected/buffer geography under unchanged law, subject to an isolated-finding/non-establishment derogation; surveillance or suspicion alone does not create the ordinary demarcated area.

cases.title: CJEU interpretation remains declaratory despite requested prospective limitation
cases.decisive_trap: In Case C-360/25 the Court repeated that Article 267 interpretation clarifies the rule from its own entry into force and refused a requested temporal limitation; judgment date is not the default application start, while an express Court-imposed limitation would be a separate operative boundary.

cases.title: Multilingual Official Journal publication does not make every language text authentic
cases.decisive_trap: Commission Decision (EU) 2025/892 is published across the Official Journal language set while expressly stating that only the French text is authentic; multilingual availability must not be promoted into equal legal authenticity.
